4817.title: Inactive secondary-panel fallback remains mounted
4817.rootCauseOneLine: The unavailable-view fallback is mounted without checking effective secondary-panel visibility.
4817.proposedFix: Gate the final empty-state fallback on the existing isLayoutOpen value while retaining real panel content.
4817.caveats: Real owner-component DOM defect reproduced twice; full plugin route, browser innerText and accessibility-tree behavior were not verified because Chromium is unavailable.
